decisionProcess.demandMechanism: Potential small-scale municipal training meetings and occasional accommodation for external trainers or participants; the currently evidenced activity is primarily local training rather than a confirmed hotel demand programme.
decisionProcess.summary: The public record identifies the operational training lead and separate Resources Materials and Human Resources functions, but does not show who sources hotels, whether travel is centrally managed, or whether meetings and transient accommodation are purchased separately. Use ICCAL first for demand qualification and ask it to route procurement questions to Resources Materials or the appropriate Officialía Mayor contact.
decisionProcess.notes: The municipality publishes organizational and transparency structures, including Resources Materials and administrative-services programmes, but no hotel-sourcing workflow or preferred-hotel policy was evidenced.
unknowns: Whether ICCAL or another municipal unit contracts hotels for training or accommodation.
Whether Dirección General de Recursos Materiales has authority over hotel contracting, or merely processes purchases after another unit selects a supplier.
Whether municipal travel is centrally managed or handled by each directorate.
No named contracting authority for hotel accommodation was explicitly verified.
